customer.primary: Individual U.S. resident with a civic issue, desired outcome, and ZIP code.

tam.basis: 258000000 adults x 10% civic-issue intent x 3% paid conversion x $15 AOV
tam.honesty: assumption: rounded demographic memory and repo price points; no live source

sam.basis: 5000000 reachable users x 3% paid conversion x $15 AOV

revenueStreams: future organization/API access only after individual loop validation

unitEconomics.honesty: evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md planning floor; not observed

revenueAssumptions: $15 starting average order value from fixed tiers
refund/failed-delivery burden below 10% of paid orders
costAssumptions: $132.50/month planning max burn from project doc
20% variable cost until real LLM/email/manual-review costs are reconciled
sensitivityTests: 1% conversion drops Year A revenue from $7500 to $2500
$5 AOV drops Year A revenue from $7500 to $2500
$3 manual review cost across 12000 campaigns adds $36000 variable cost

competition.positioning: Paid individual utility with research, citation verification, routing, drafting, payment, and delivery in one workflow.

antiPlan.summary: Do not invest until paid demand and delivery reliability are proven; a complete AI workflow is not market proof.

holes.hole: Federal officials may not accept email delivery because Congress.gov returns no emails.
holes.mitigation: Run official-routing spike and implement email/web-form fallback before paid launch.
holes.residualRisk: Office policies and contact methods remain outside product control.

holes.hole: Low ticket size makes CAC dangerous.
holes.mitigation: Use organic/operator-led beta before paid acquisition.
holes.residualRisk: SEO or community channels may not convert.

holes.hole: Legal, lobbying, harassment, and CAN-SPAM posture is unresolved.
holes.mitigation: Keep disclaimers, moderation, human review, and obtain operator/legal review.
holes.residualRisk: No legal opinion exists in repo.

holes.hole: Registry says watchlist and personal/research asset.
holes.residualRisk: The operator may decide it should not pitch as a business.

dailyWork: monitor delivery failures and bounce rates
